one_line: Open on a real moment that states the parent's problem, then reveal the book as the answer by 0:10.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 first-person view of an ultrasound: a probe on a belly, a parent carrying a toddler pointing at the wall monitor. Voiceover (transcript) and subtitles: "כבר תקופה שאני מנסה להסביר" (0:01), "שעוד מעט היא הופכת לאחות גדולה" (0:04).
q1_hook.why: A real, emotional situation in the first frame, said and subtitled together (H1, H6). The unanswered need, how to tell a toddler about a baby, is answered at 0:10 with the book (H5). The product is only a closed box at 0:04, so the promise lands at about 0:09 (H2, S1).

beats.what: Ultrasound POV, toddler pointing at the monitor; "כבר תקופה שאני מנסה להסביר"
beats.why: A real moment states the problem

beats.what: Toddler with a doll, a MeBook.ai box, toddler pointing at a laptop; "ואז גיליתי את MeBook"
beats.why: Problem to solution at 0:05, with cutaways of the child

beats.what: Laptop builder with a family photo; finished cover held still; toddler opens a box, laughs
beats.why: The book is revealed at 0:10, the child's delight follows

beats.what: Top-down page flips (pregnant mother, toy shop, stroller); mother reads with the toddler
beats.why: Shows the sibling story pages, a new angle every 1 to 3 s

beats.what: Ordering-site screen for 1 s; pages with a crying newborn; "אפשר ליצור להם סיפור"
beats.why: Widens the use to other milestones, the least personal stretch

beats.what: Mother smiles at the camera, the toddler laughs, mother turns pages
beats.why: A warm child reaction before the closing line

beats.what: Back cover held still: round photo, MeBook.ai, QR code; last 3 s without text
beats.why: Closing line answers the opening problem; the tail is static

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None asked. A sendable moment exists for a friend expecting a second child (how to tell a toddler), but nothing says to send it, and the caption has no question.
q2_flow.why: A problem, a turn at 0:05 and a reveal at 0:10 form a short arc with a new visual every 1 to 3 s (K2, R3). The toddler's laughs at 0:13 and 0:28 are the warm peaks (K1). The 0:22 to 0:27 drift and the static last 3 s are where it sags (R1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video or caption: no link, word or ask. A QR code and "Another MeBook? Scan the code" are printed on the back cover (0:33-0:39), part of the product. The caption ends with the tag @mebook.ai.
q3_cta.why: A convinced viewer has no next step: nothing said or shown, only the caption tag (C6). The sell stays light, one brand name on a box and a back cover (C7), but there is no question to answer either (C5), so it cannot prompt replies.

q4_shown.what: Closed MeBook.ai box 0:04; laptop builder with a family photo 0:09; finished cover held still 0:10-0:13; toddler opening a box 0:13; page flips 0:15-0:27; ordering-site cover picker on a phone 0:22; back cover with the child's round photo and QR code 0:33-0:39. No price.
q4_shown.why: The builder and order page show how a parent personalises, and the cover shows the child as hero (S8). A mother's first-person story vouches for it (S6). Real photo and illustration never share a frame (S2). The book is handled only from 0:10 (S1). Face and name appear together (S5).

q5_edit.what: 16 shots in 40 s, about 2.5 s each; hard cuts, 8 of the 15 in the first 15 s. Two-line subtitles, phrase by phrase, synced to the voiceover. No speed changes. Ends on a static 7 s back cover, last 3 s without text.
q5_edit.why: Quick cuts and varied angles early keep it moving (E1, E2), then 4 to 7 s holds after 0:17. Voice with synced chunks works muted (E4). The last 3 s of a still cover add nothing after the final line (E8, R1).

q6_topic.what: How a pregnant mother explained a coming sibling to her toddler with a personalised book, then "you can make a story about anything". Serves parents facing a hard talk.
q6_topic.why: A new sibling is a real concern that leaves parents feeling understood (K6) and a life moment tied to a buyer (K7). "Easier through a story" is a modest claim inside a feeling (K4). A friend expecting a second child is someone to send it to (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld first-person POV at the scan; handheld close-ups of the toddler at home; propped top-down on a plain light counter for cover, pages and back cover; a side-on handheld on a sofa. Daylight. A phone screen capture with narrow black side bars at 0:22.
q7_filmed.why: The POV opening feels lived and native (H8, F7). Top-down hands on a plain counter fill the frame with the cover and pages (F4, F5). The bars around the 0:22 screenshot break the full-frame rule for that second (F1, F3).

q8_text.on_screen: Regular-weight white subtitles, two short lines, about 80% down, phrase by phrase: "כבר תקופה שאני מנסה להסביר" (0:01), "שעוד מעט היא הופכת לאחות גדולה" (0:04), "ואז גיליתי את MeBook" (0:05), "יצרתי לה ספר שבו היא הדמות הראשית" (0:12), "אפשר ליצור להם סיפור" (0:25), "במילים הרבה יותר קל להם" (0:35). No text 0:37-0:39. No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "כמה מרגש שסוף סוף מצאתי דרך להמחיש" (the child's name follows). About 45 words in three feeling sentences, emojis, the @mebook.ai tag. No hashtags, question, CTA or disclosure words.
q8_text.why: Phrase-by-phrase subtitles carry the story for a muted viewer (T1) but are nearly the whole transcript (T2) and sit low, in the bottom 35% (T4). "MeBook" in Latin letters sits inside a Hebrew line (T6). The caption has no search keywords or hashtags (T7) and discloses only by tag (T8).

weak_points: No CTA or question; the partnership only tagged; the child's face with her name on the back cover and in the caption; the generic-uses drift at 0:22; a static last 3 s; subtitles low in the frame.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with a first-person life moment (a scan, a packed bag) as text plus voice, then top-down hands show cover and pages, a preview screen recording, one ask.
not_verified: Whether the ultrasound footage is the creator's own. Whether the voice is the creator's. The 0:06 subtitle reads "MeBook AI" in Latin letters inside a Hebrew line. Music and natural sound are not evident. Correction to src/coded: likeness_proof "photo beside illustration" does not hold, the real photo (laptop 0:09, back cover 0:33) and the illustration never share a frame. Whether the post was paid.
